name: Forest Ground 05
description: Free 16K texture of compact forest soil: dark brown earth with fine grit, small stones and faint leaf fragments, slightly damp, subtle roughness and variation.
info: This forest ground was scanned near the entrance of the Ichikawa Zoo, in Japan. The zoo became really famous when a [video](https://x.com/Euphorbia10182/status/2018888215525269643) about a baby monkey (Punch!) holding a monkey plushie as a substitute mother went viral.
